---
title: "Protein structure"
description: "Inspect protein structures and connect quantitative candidates to structural context."
---

## Purpose

The Protein Structure toolkit helps move from a candidate protein identifier or structure file to a three-dimensional view. ProtVis includes structure-related dependencies such as `bio3d` and `r3dmol`, and also exposes a SwissModel-oriented utility in the Toolkits menu.

## Recommended workflow

1. Resolve the candidate to a stable protein identifier.
2. Obtain or upload the structure format expected by the selected toolkit.
3. Confirm chain/residue numbering before mapping a mutation, PTM or domain of interest.
4. Generate the interactive or static structural view.
5. Record the structure source and model/entry identifier in the figure legend or Methods.

::: {.callout-warning}
Predicted structures and experimental structures are not equivalent evidence. When using a model, report its source and confidence/quality metrics and avoid over-interpreting poorly supported regions.
:::
